intentAndPurpose.intent: The one public layout wrapper — constrains children width via variant (fluid / fixed / full-bleed) + maxWidth, plus the shared token-resolved flex-layout props (direction/gap/padding*/align/justify/wrap/flex). ALSO establishes a surface-context boundary internally: `mode` defaults to 'ghost' (transparent, same step as parent — no visual change from plain layout use), or pass mode="bold"/"subtle"/etc. + appearance to make this Container a real colour region, exactly like the old <Surface> component (now internal-only, not part of the public API). a11y-transparent.

props.name: variant
props.description: fluid = grows with parent; fixed = capped at maxWidth; full-bleed = edge-to-edge.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Width cap — number (px) or string (dim). Honoured for variant="fixed".

props.name: mode
props.description: Surface mode for this layout boundary. Container always establishes a surface-context boundary internally; 'ghost' (the default) paints no fill and keeps the parent's step, so callers that never pass `mode` see no visual change. Pass 'bold'/'subtle'/etc. to make this Container a real colour region.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Which role fills the surface when `mode` paints a real fill. Default resolves to primary.

props.name: gap
props.description: Token-only spacing between children — a NativeSpacingKey (e.g. "6"), a Figma "dimensions/spacings/N" path, or a "Spacing-N" alias. NEVER a raw pixel number/string — resolveSpacingPx silently drops unresolvable values.

props.name: padding
props.description: Token-only padding on all sides. Same value shape as `gap`.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Token-only horizontal padding. Same value shape as `gap`.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Token-only vertical padding. Same value shape as `gap`.

props.name: flex
props.description: Flex-grow factor — a plain number IS valid here (not a spacing token).

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height — a NativeSpacingKey/token path (same shape as `gap`) OR a raw dp number (a plain number IS valid here, unlike `gap`). Use to size a horizontal `ScrollView` rail, which RN cannot cross-axis-size from content: wrap the ScrollView in `<Container minHeight={N}>` instead of a raw `View`.
